name: Error Identification
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 999.5010X231.A1.xml. IK302 (Segment Position in Transaction Set) is a 1-based count of segments from ST — modeled N0 (whole number), matching this schema's own convention for other position-count elements (CTX03/CTX05-01, etc.). IK304's valid_codes (1-8, I4, I6-I9) are the standard X12 Segment Syntax Error Code table — not modeled inline since this schema's own established convention (see CLP.json/CAS.json) never populates enumerated valid-code lists, only dataType/length.
